answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Gitcoin passport score proof, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 15 minutes; a farm of 579 pays 8685 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. What carries the sable here is verification, the ledge of cost is what stops the farm, and the beacon of the record keeps every claim checkable. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
